title: Twitch launches Recaps Spotlight to promote streamer clips on social media
description: Twitch's October 27, 2026 post launches Recaps Spotlight: distribution partners may share standout Recap clips on Instagram and YouTube, rolling out to Partners first.
summary: On October 27, 2026, Twitch launched Recaps Spotlight, the first program in what it calls a broader investment in promoting streamer clips, including beyond Twitch. Twitch's distribution partners may select standout clips from a streamer's Stream Recap and post them on their own social accounts on platforms such as Instagram and YouTube.

Twitch says every promoted clip credits the streamer and points viewers back to the Twitch channel. Streamers join through Clip Settings on web, and there is no cost. The post says the more consistently a streamer reviews and curates their Recaps, the more content is available to be considered.
The rollout starts with Partners only over a couple of days. Twitch describes this phase as a way to learn and develop the program, and says opportunities could open to Affiliates in the future.
why_it_matters: For Partners, the program adds a possible discovery channel without extra production work, but selection is up to Twitch's distribution partners, so it is not a guaranteed placement. Affiliates cannot join yet.

Streamers who run their own clip-posting workflow can treat this as a complement, not a replacement: curating Recaps is now the input to both Twitch's feeds and the Spotlight program.
